completion_criteria.text: hooks/lib/pre-tool-use.mjs inverted to deny-by-default inside a protected root: any resolvable token under a protected root DENIES unless the segment head is on an explicit read-only allowlist. shell-tokens.mjs left unchanged.

Both directions proven by committed tests: all 12 verified evasions (including `( rm -rf <root> )` and `sudo rm -rf <root>`) assert DENY, and the 41-command read-only corpus asserts ALLOW. Red-before/green-after evidence recorded.
The scanSegments blow-up resolved so the guard fails CLOSED on oversized or pathological input, never open, with a test asserting the fail-closed path at the boundary.
Full plugin test suite green on the branch, and a fresh code-reviewer plus security-reviewer pass over the final diff returns no CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

Branch merged to main, plugin published to the marketplace, and re-installed globally - then a live end-to-end check against the real store shows a real evasion DENIED and ordinary read commands still ALLOWED.

spine.active_goal: Invert the PreToolUse Bash guard from allow-unless-provably-destructive to deny-by-default inside a protected root, so parse gaps in the hand-rolled bash tokenizer stop being silent evasions. Then prove both directions, review, merge, publish, re-install. Successor to ledger-v2-archive-and-seed.
spine.next_step: Two agents in flight: empirical OLD-vs-TIP verdict matrix, and the deny-by-default design (decisions A-H incl. a possible three-state allow/deny/ask). When both land, settle the design with the user, then TDD the inversion. DO NOT merge before the two-way proof.
open_risks: The 12-evasion and 41-command corpora DO NOT EXIST as artifacts - they were planning targets. Only test/unit/hooks/pre-tool-use.test.mjs exists: 23 blocks, 51 asserts, not table-driven. Treat 12/41 as coverage floors. See decision 0014.

BIGGER FAIL-OPEN THAN THE PARSE GAPS: pre-tool-use.mjs:115-116 returns {} - a total bypass of every check for every tool - whenever roots resolves empty. gitCommonDir drops a root silently on any git failure.

hook-io.mjs:50-57 swallows every exception and exits 0 silently; readHookInput returns {} on malformed stdin. Both are silent ALLOW. runEntry is shared by ALL hooks, so a global fail-closed change risks breaking sessions.

shell-tokens.mjs sets `unresolvable` ONLY for double-quoted spans containing $ or a backtick. Bare $VAR, $(...), backticks and globs are NOT flagged - they become garbled literal text that misses a root by accident, not by design.

CRITERIA TENSION: criterion 1 freezes shell-tokens.mjs but the scanSegments quadratic lives there (spread-copy at :64 and :72). Resolve by capping input in pre-tool-use.mjs BEFORE it calls scanSegments, leaving the tokenizer byte-unchanged.

CORRECTION, do not re-add as if missing: the tip ALREADY checks redirect targets head-independently (:66-68) and ALREADY tracks cd across && segments (:72-74). The gap is solely the 14-verb DESTRUCTIVE head set at :76.

Pipes are segment boundaries, so `find / | xargs rm -rf X` presents xargs as the head and the rm is never seen. Deny-by-default covers this only because xargs is not allowlisted - incidental, so keep a test on it.
isUnderRoot is a textual prefix test with no realpath resolution, so a symlink pointing into the store is not seen as under it. Out of scope for the inversion but it is a live hole.

STATUS QUO IS SAFER. Live 0fe1c02 rule is hasMutatingConstruct(cmd) && cmd.includes(root); its leading char class includes `(`, which is why it catches `( rm -rf ROOT )` and `sudo rm -rf ROOT` that the tip misses.
Concurrent sessions write ONE store. 0012 was taken by another session while this one wrote 0013/0014. Decision numbers are not contiguous.
Spine list items are capped at 300 chars each; an over-cap item rejects the WHOLE update_thread call. Completion criteria are immutable after creation.
key_decisions: 0014-evasion-corpora-never-existed - 12/41 are coverage floors, not artifacts; the existing 51 assertions need verdicts rewritten, not just extended
Predecessor 0007-guard-scope-defect-refuted - CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA reaches hooks; store is protected today
out_of_scope: Ref-level destruction: git update-ref -d refs/heads/_ledger, git branch -D _ledger, and deletion of <repo>/.git/worktrees/ledger-worktree. Uncovered by BOTH guards; the ref is the authoritative data. Tracked separately, not fixed here.
Rewriting shell-tokens.mjs. It is kept as-is; only the decision rule inverts.
The other four canonical stores - future rollout, per-repo.
`ledger-cli sync` and any publication of the `_ledger` ref.
